query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.receivableId) as com_acao, COUNT(DISTINCT cmt.receivable_id) as com_ticks FROM collection_actions ca INNER JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ca.receivableId LEFT JOIN collection_manual_ticks cmt ON cmt.receivable_id = ca.receivableId WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < '2026-05-11T00:00:00';
